result.decision_rationale: All four blocking findings are resolved. The Release gate passed at the candidate, and the Debug run exercised all 13 focused children with bin/Release unavailable. The lifecycle tests now cover both persistence timing and stopped-service dispatch. One optional correction remains in the test mapping. OWNER AMENDMENT 1 reserves native gameplay and save/load acceptance for the integrated-alpha playtest.

The Release log records 51 passing Trip contract checks, 83 companion-reader checks, 114 Mounted Shield checks and 68 rollback checks. The packet, production and embedded shield icon bytes matched.

The committed Debug log records a 31.1-second run at acdb7198 with bin/Release moved aside, 13 of 13 children passing and exit status 0. Both UMM profiles bound all 20 referenced members against the Debug product. The developer’s log checksum is reproducible from the committed text with its original mixed line endings.

prior_finding_assessments.rationale: The Debug log shows the invocation, the directory listing with Release moved aside, and 83 passing reader checks. The reader loaded bin/Debug/KingmakerMountedCombat.dll with SHA-256 7b233483f90205f42a051a2fe540484826c0824e697e4f93bd703352c310e88a and MVID 5f8fce8d-1e4f-4a7e-8438-23c1c750dd2e.

The wrapper forwards Configuration to every child that declares it and preserves the existing profile and reference arguments. The Debug log shows the six affected invocations selecting Debug, including the UMM 0.31.1 and 0.33.0 product bindings.

The lifecycle fixture and repair host now read the same save and load state. The passing component case checks that a refused disable retains armed consent. Holding either operation open produces a guarded refusal, zero removal calls and no replay after settlement. Settling before dispatch produces one classified exact removal.

The passing lifecycle case retains immediate re-enable coverage and restores both stop controls through ServiceLifecycleSequence.Disable. A stopped update exposes zero offers and makes zero removal calls. Dispatching consent taken before the stop records the stopped refusal and leaves the fact present.

The mapping now describes the direct classifier test and the rapid-click test correctly. Its claim about every other successful repair still conflicts with the final selection and confirmation of B in TwoHorsesAndCancellation. This remains optional wording polish.

summary.delivered_behavior: Fresh KMC horses exclude the stock Mammoth donor’s Bite-triggered Trip grant and retain their bite and two hooves. For an existing horse, the UMM action explains the provenance ambiguity, requests confirmation for one eligible fact, and rechecks the live horse, stable ID, fact instance, session and write gate before removal. Legacy request files are inert.
remaining_owner_review: N07. Observe a plain horse land a damaging bite without automatic Trip. Where available, compare a legitimate dog or wolf Trip and an explicit or independently granted maneuver.
Check that the UMM panel clearly identifies the horse, owner and proposed removal, and that confirmation and cancellation are understandable in play.
N10. Save and reload a repaired horse and verify that the repair persists, the pair remains usable, and restoration introduces no duplicate effects or extra action.
